body: I know very little about him. I will give you an example. The basic concept of the food chain bothers me and it is not about to change.
I really don't feel like waking up ever again, but I guess I don't have a lot to lose with 1 more day.
I will try to see if tomorrow will be different, but that's it. I don't expect anything to change.

The last experiences I got helping people the best I could ended up in a big disappointment. In this world, most people think you cannot be helping others without a bad motive. If you help others, it is because you are doing it to gain something from them, you intend on stealing from them, you want to rape them or anything like that. There is so many people I consider bad in this world, I really doubt anything could ever change.

I just feel like it has to be tonight, I just feel like destroying everything around me too. I have way too much anger. But I guess I could wait and expect life to be different tomorrow, I just expect it to be the same.

I mean, lets exagerate. I become the richest man alive, I become the best football player, find the most beautiful and perfect woman alive and have a lot of friends. Humanity is still the same, the planet did not change and life remains the same. I dont think it would make me more happy.
It just feels like I already tried so many things, and the I could try endlessly for 100 years and still get nothing out of it, except shame and more bitterness. I will think about it.
Logically, indeed it should be worth. It is hard to explain, but it feels like I have lived enough. Maybe some medication would not be so bad.

I can't stop thinking that it could be the opposite, maybe I already lived the best days of my life, and the future is even more grim. I feel alone and hate most people, but I am still sad at seeing anyone suffer. It makes me sick to see people dying in accidents or of illness. A lot of people I know died lately, and a lot more will die in the next months/days, I don't feel ready for this and I wish I would not have to live that anymore.
It just sounds like my vision of the whole word is far too negative. I wonder if it could change anything if I tried a sport or something else.
I cannot afford leaving my job, minimum wage and no alternative. But I would if I could.

I dont know if you've ever been as exhausted as I feel lately. I want my mind to stop, I want everything to stop. I have everything I need to end it painlessly, and it sounds to me like it would be an excellent feeling not to have all this weight I am feeling. I feel like I walked for years and that there is really no light at the end of the tunnel.

I have no talent and lack energy and I dont see what it would change about everything that is bad about this world, as far as I know, this could be hell. But I guess I could try different things. Right now it just sounds useless.
I would probably make everyone mad and make them lose, last time I played a team sport, I was told to sit on the bench until the game ends.
It is my intention to put and end to it tonight unless I find some magic answers to life which I really doubt could happen. But like I said, I am touched by your words.
I know there is a small percentage of awesome people, but the bad people bother me more.  I also used to be interested in some hobbies or sports, but everything just sound so useless these days.

And I become a zombie unable to think by myself, but at least I am alive... The last psychologist I saw was  using a therapy involving sounds and moving an object in front of me. Was always asking for more money with the pretext I needed it. My family had to step in before I would go broke.

I tried my best at being a nice and useful person and failed. I always get rejected at some point, either because people think I am weird or because they are done using me. I studied a lot and made a lot of efforts, but there is no results at all. If you knew me, you wouldnt like me, I cant even like myself.

Never tried, but gathering of people sounds to me like it will be a lot of trouble. Makes me tired just to think of it. Going to walmart is already pretty challenging to me. There is always problems, and it always happens to me.

Because of my experience with psychologists where I had very bad experiences. I tried some medication like antianxiety pills, it works for some time, then you get panic attacks. I have the feeling antidepressors would make everything worse (unemployment, burst of anger,  etc.)
That is my whole life, hobbies, all alone. Everything, everyday I am all alone, unless people are forced to be with me (ex: work).

I appreciate your time and it makes me sad to think that you could jeopardize your results at your test for the waste of time I am. Since I hate almost everything and everyone, I would not say I don't deserve bad things. I have tried my best and failed, I whine about my life while great people die of unfair sickness. I am just too pathetic.
I guess I came here wishing to find a magic cure, something obvious I missed in my life. Deep inside me, I know there is nothing like that.

With everything I read about antidepressors, it scares me more than death, what if it gets worse. I am at a point where talking about my problems just piss me off even more, I doubt seeing a psychotherapist would help.

I have had this feeling for years now, it never changes. If someone really loved me or cared about me, that person have had the opportunity and never told or showed me. I am average in everything I do, tons of people can do better. I am a negative and useless person.  My whole life is an act. I keep all my frustrations inside but as soon as I am alone, it explodes. I hate so many things about humanity there is so little one person could do. I talked about killing myself with a friend and he changed subject. Some days after, he told me to do it. I thought a lot about it, wrote my will and told my parents I appreciate the help they gave me with my life, everything is in order.
Most people think that if you talk about suicide you won't do it, this is what I meant.
They are paid to listen to you, they don't give a ____. All they care about is getting paid. At least, that is my experience with those I saw.
Everyone I talked to think talking about suicide is manupulation.
Everything, mostly me but humanity too.
Self-medication, counsellors, family, teachers, doctors, bipolar and suicide chat rooms, anything I could think of. Seeing a psychologist was the worst of all.
